This template describes a standard workflow for analyzing single cell PNA data using the `pixelatorR` package in R. This is the stand-alone validation set of five axi-cel samples (t0 vs t1) that mirrors the `pna_b1b2` analysis; only the t1 vs t0 axi-cel comparison is tested. It covers data loading, quality control, clustering, annotation, abundance, proximity, optional statistical testing, optional single-cell graph visualization, and optional data interpretation.

**Important:** Users must actively review and adjust quality control thresholds, select markers, and most critically, perform manual cell type annotation based on marker expression patterns. Automated annotation provides a starting point but should always be verified and refined through careful inspection of differential abundance patterns and marker distributions.

**How to run interactively:** Open and run the numbered notebooks in `modules/` in order (`01` through `04`; `05` is optional, `02b` is the separate platelet clean-up and `08` makes the supplementary figures). Start with `01_quality_control.qmd`. R packages come from the shared renv project in the root directory (`renv::restore()`); open the project from the `.Rproj` file in this folder so it loads automatically.

**How to re-render everything:** Render this file when you want a single HTML report of the full workflow at the end of a project (requires [Quarto](https://quarto.org/)).

**Where to edit:** Steps that depend on your experiment are labeled **Decision checkpoint** in each module. Search for **Decision checkpoint** in the module you are running.

```         
│   ├── 01_quality_control.qmd

│   ├── 04_proximity_cleaned.qmd

```

**Note:**

- All plots are saved in both PDF and PNG formats.
- Folder numbering (01–05, 02b, 08) corresponds to the analysis modules. `results_cleaned/` holds the output of `modules_cleaned/`.
